text:
June (People Ops): Quick pulse 1: proposing a one-hour "Thankathon" next Thursday 2-3pm: quick shoutouts, 1-min spotlight slots, and a pilot to let managers convert up to 2 tokens per team into micro spot-awards (small cash) with an approval checklist. Thoughts? :sparkles:
Marco (HR): Interesting. Policy Q first: what's the approval flow for manager conversions? Need clarity on tax and audit before piloting.
June (People Ops): Plan: swag-first by default. If a manager wants a cash conversion we require: 1) manager fill spot-award form, 2) reference original nomination ID, 3) brief justification. Marco, can you confirm tax implications?
Marco (HR): Will do. High-level: conversions >$50 may have different reporting. I'll loop in finance for the exact threshold and create a one-page checklist.
Priya - Eng: Love the idea. For the spotlight slots, can we limit to 6 people with strict 60s each? Keeps it snappy. Also want a remote-friendly option.
June (People Ops): Yes 6 quick slots, sign-ups first-come on the form. Remote folks can 60s via Zoom + we mail a sticker token or send a $5 e-gift if international.
Sam - Sales: Recruitment tie-in idea: can we give a small referral shoutout token to folks who helped hire? Asha, does recruiting want to plug in a "referral shoutout" field?
Asha - Recruiting: We can. Suggest a separate checkbox on the form: "This nomination is tied to hiring/referral assistance." We'll capture recruiter name and role. Helps with hiring ops credit.
Olive (Facilities): For on-site setup I can reserve the north lounge and supply a small table, two mic stands, and a sign. Need final headcount by Wed 10am.
June (People Ops): Volunteers: setup 1:30-1:55, host 2:00-3:00 (two people to manage mic + roster), teardown 3:00-3:15. Who can take which?
Priya - Eng: I can host the engineering mic pass and help with setup at 1:30.
Sam - Sales: I'll host sales/people ops mic pass and help with teardown.
Asha - Recruiting: I'll manage the referral shoutout segment and moderate the sign-up list.
kudos-bot: Auto: "New nomination: Lina nominated for helping close the Puppet PR earlier this week! :tada:"
finance-bot: Auto: "Reminder: Any cash awards require finance approval. Marco to share threshold."
Marco (HR): FWIW finance flagged: cash conversions under $50 are low-risk; above that we need additional paperwork. I'll confirm by EOD tomorrow and post a short FAQ.
June (People Ops): Great. Other logistics: form fields = your name (optional), nominee, one-line reason (max 140 chars), remote? (Y/N), referral-related? (checkbox), optional consent for conversion. Form open 72hrs.
Priya - Eng: Can we make the form anonymous by default (opt-in name)? Some folks prefer that.
Asha - Recruiting: Anonymous default is fine, but for referral-credit we need a non-anon field for the referrer. We'll make that conditional.
June (People Ops): Perfect. Communication: short Slack blurb + 8.5x11 poster + Notion page with checklist and manager conversion steps. Sam, can you help with a short testimonial blurb from sales?
Sam - Sales: Yep I can draft a 1-liner and a tiny example people can copy into the form.
Marco (HR): I'll upload the manager conversion checklist and link to the spot-award form once finance confirms the threshold. Also will add the tax note.
June (People Ops): Action items: June publish form by Tue 9am, Marco confirm policy + checklist by Tue EOD, Olive confirm room Wed 11am, Asha handle referral field, Priya + Sam host. Thanks team!
finance-bot: Auto: "FYI: Confirmed cash award low-risk threshold = $50. See finance playbook."
notes: Thankathon event + pilot manager-conversion-to-spot-award workflow; volunteer shifts; form fields and remote options; finance threshold follow-up
